# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge
We pledge to make participation in Patungan a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size,
disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education,
socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our Standards
- Be respectful and constructive; critique code and ideas, not people.
- Assume good faith, and accept feedback gracefully.
- No harassment, trolling, insults, or publishing others' private information.

## Enforcement
Report unacceptable behaviour privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting or to the maintainer
([@edycutjong](https://github.com/edycutjong) on GitHub). Reports are reviewed promptly and kept confidential.

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
